name: atlas-enterprise-suite
description: ATLAS Enterprise Suite production-ready web, PWA and mobile foundation

scripts.check:js: node --check app.js && node --check server.js && node --check service-worker.js && node --check cloud-auth.js && node --check private-beta.js && node --check private-beta-recovery.js && node --check atlas-config.js && node --check atlas-gps-4d.js && node --check scripts/build-cloudflare.js
scripts.validate: npm run check:js && npm run check:db
scripts.cloudflare:dev: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4 dev
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run validate && npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler@4 deploy
